name: Antalyze Live Chat and AI Chatbot
author: antalyze

sections.description:
The Antalyze Live Chat and AI Chatbot plugin brings enterprise-grade AI customer support to your WordPress site. Transform your website’s customer experience with intelligent AI-powered conversations, omnichannel support, and advanced integrations.

🚀 All-in-One AI Chatbot Platform

Antalyze is trusted by hundreds of businesses for automating customer support, increasing engagement, and driving growth with intelligent AI solutions.

⭐ Key Features

  • Easy Setup: Install and configure in minutes – Go live in under 10 minutes
  • Multiple Display Types: Choose between Bubble chat or FSP (Full Screen Page) widget
  • Page Control: Select which pages to display the widget on
  • Exclude Pages: Specify pages where the widget shouldn’t appear
  • Responsive Design: Works perfectly on desktop and mobile devices
  • No Coding Required: Simple point-and-click configuration
  • Lightweight: Minimal impact on site performance

🌐 Omnichannel Support

  • Multi-Platform Integration: Web, WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger
  • Unified Experience: Consistent customer support across all channels
  • Social Media Ready: Seamless integration with social platforms

🛍️ E-commerce Integration

  • Shopify & WooCommerce: Direct integration with your store
  • Product Intelligence: Bot understands your products, inventory, and orders
  • Purchase Assistance: Help customers with purchases and inquiries
  • Order Management: Automated order tracking and support

🧠 Advanced AI Technology

  • Semantic Search: Contextual understanding for accurate responses
  • Document-Based Training: Upload PDFs, DOCX, TXT, FAQs, Notion pages
  • Knowledge Base Management: Centralized documentation system
  • Real-time Learning: AI improves from every interaction

👥 Intelligent Support System

  • Smart Ticket System: Automated ticket creation with full context
  • Live Chat Monitoring: Human agents can take over any conversation
  • Team Collaboration: Seamless handoffs between AI and human agents
  • Agent Permissions: Manage team access and responsibilities

📊 Analytics & Insights

  • Performance Dashboard: Deep insights into chat performance and engagement
  • Topic & Intent Analysis: Understand what customers are asking
  • Real-time Monitoring: Live dashboards with instant alerts
  • KPI Tracking: Monitor and optimize your support metrics

🌍 Global & Enterprise Features

  • Multi-Language Support: 40+ languages with automatic detection
  • Real-time Translation: Break language barriers instantly
  • Enterprise Security: GDPR compliance and encrypted communications
  • Custom Integrations: APIs for Slack, Teams, Salesforce, and more

💡 Why Choose Antalyze?

Antalyze provides cutting-edge AI chat technology that helps you:
– 24/7 Customer Engagement: Intelligent responses around the clock
– Lead Capture: Automatically capture and qualify leads
– Instant Support: Provide immediate customer assistance
– Increase Conversions: Guide customers through the purchase process
– Reduce Support Costs: Automate routine inquiries and tasks
– Scale Globally: Support customers in their native language

Getting Started

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Get your Widget ID from your Antalyze Dashboard
  3. Go to Settings > Antalyze Chat in your WordPress admin
  4. Enter your Widget ID and configure settings
  5. Save and enjoy intelligent chat on your site!

Support

Need help? We’re here for you:
– Documentation
– Support Center
– Contact Us

Privacy Policy

This plugin connects to the Antalyze service to provide chat functionality. When users interact with the chat widget, their messages and basic information may be sent to Antalyze servers for processing. Please review Antalyze’s privacy policy at https://antalyze.ai/privacy for more information about data handling.

Third-party Services

This plugin relies on the Antalyze service:
– Service URL: https://app.antalyze.ai
– Privacy Policy: https://antalyze.ai/privacy
– Terms of Service: https://antalyze.ai/terms

Source Code and Build Instructions

The human‑readable source for our minified chat widget is public:
https://github.com/errahulcs/Antalyze-Live-Chat-and-AI-Chatbot

Readable files: chat-widget.js, chat-widget.css
Minified files (distributed in this plugin): dist/chat-widget.min.js, dist/chat-widget.min.css

To reproduce the minified files from the readable ones, see the build steps in the repository README.

WordPress.org Compliance Note:
The chat widget has been optimized for WordPress.org compliance. All external dependencies (including Swiper CSS) are now loaded locally to prevent remote CDN calls. The plugin enqueues all necessary stylesheets and scripts from the local plugin directory only.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Antalyze Live Chat and AI Chatbot”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
  5. Go to Settings > Antalyze Chat to configure
  6. Add your “Your unique widget ID from Antalyze dashboard” e.g., 53467bye-7146-45ef-add5-4ec5d072846b.
  7. That’s all, your bot is ready to answer all your user queries.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file (https://antalyze.ai/wordpress-plugin/)
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin
  6. Go to Settings > Antalyze Chat to configure

Configuration

  1. Sign up for an account at Antalyze
  2. Create your chat bot and copy the Widget ID
  3. In WordPress, go to Settings > Antalyze Chat
  4. Paste your Widget ID
  5. Configure display settings as needed
  6. Save settings
sections.faq:
Do I need an Antalyze account?

Yes, you need to create a free account at app.antalyze.ai to access the full AI chatbot platform, including omnichannel support, analytics, and advanced integrations.

Is there a free plan?

Yes! Antalyze offers a free trial to get you started. You can go live in under 10 minutes and explore features like multi-language support, e-commerce integration, and analytics. Check our pricing page for details.

Will this slow down my website?

No, the plugin is designed to be lightweight and loads asynchronously to ensure no impact on your site’s performance.

Can I customize the appearance?

Yes, you can choose between bubble and FSP (Full page display) display types. Additional customization options are available in your Antalyze dashboard.

Which pages will show the chat widget?

You can choose to display the widget on all pages, homepage only, posts only, or pages only. You can also exclude specific pages by ID or slug.

Does it support multiple languages?

Absolutely! Antalyze supports 40+ languages with automatic detection and real-time translation, making it perfect for global businesses.

Can it integrate with my e-commerce store?

Yes! Antalyze has direct integrations with Shopify and WooCommerce. The AI bot understands your products, inventory, and orders to assist customers with purchases.

What about social media integration?

Antalyze provides omnichannel support across Web, WhatsApp, Instagram, and Messenger for a unified customer experience across all platforms.

Is it mobile-friendly?

Absolutely! The chat widget is fully responsive and works perfectly on all devices.

Can I use this with any WordPress theme?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with any properly coded WordPress theme.

How do I get support?

Visit our support center or contact us through your Antalyze dashboard.
